chapter_seo_title: Han Li Recovers Mana via Spirit Essence Qi Transfer—A Breather Chapter Before the Storm
chapter_meta_description: Han Li recovers a strand of mana through an unexpected qi transfer method, finally opens his storage pouch, and begins a tactical supply run—while his Crying Soul Beast grows restless in the Netherworld Domain.
og_title: A Kiss of Mana—Han Li’s First Footing in the Netherworld Domain
og_description: Mei Ning’s Spirit Essence Qi unlocks Han Li’s sealed mana for a brief window. He immediately goes on a cold, efficient supply run. But the Crying Soul Beast knows something’s coming.
twitter_title: A Strand of Mana and a Strange Beast’s Unease
twitter_description: Han Li gets his mana back just long enough to raid a supply shed. Meanwhile, the Crying Soul Beast sniffs trouble ahead.

lore_anchors.definition: A mana-sealed pocket realm within the Chaotic Star Sea, filled with ghost-mist and powered by yin force instead of standard qi.
A unique energy generated by a special female cultivation physique, capable of temporarily reactivating a sealed mana pool.
A rare spirit beast with an extraordinary sense of smell for ghost-type entities and yin energy; it serves as Han Li's supernatural threat detector.
A unique local liquid found in the Netherworld Domain, stored in large quantities and potentially useful for future formations or trade.
The third major cultivation stage, marking a cultivator as a major power in the mortal realm, with a lifespan of around 500 years and access to higher-grade techniques and treasures.
